Aiyagari1994.finiteCap_lower_bracket:
Aiyagari1994.finiteCap_lower_bracket (p : Aiyagari1994.ProductionData) (hp : Aiyagari1994.ProductionRegularity p)
  (m : Aiyagari1994.HouseholdPrimitives) (hsmooth : Aiyagari1994.UtilitySmooth m.utility)
  (hcurvature : Aiyagari1994.UtilityCurvature m.utility) (hnd : Aiyagari1994.IncomeNondegenerate m.income)
  (hmean : Aiyagari1994.LaborMeanOne m.income) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
  ∃ (K_L : ℝ),
    0 < K_L ∧
      ∃ (r_L : ↑(Aiyagari1994.FirmRate p)),
        Aiyagari1994.capitalDemand p hp r_L = K_L ∧
          ∃ (hrneg : ↑r_L < 0),
            deriv p.output K_L < p.depreciation ∧
              p.output K_L < p.depreciation * K_L ∧
                have prices := Aiyagari1994.M09A3.lowerOriginalPrices m p hp b hb r_L;
                let household := Aiyagari1994.M09A3.lowerHousehold m p hp b hb r_L;
                have hbetaR := ⋯;
                prices.debtLimit = b ∧
                  0 < 1 + ↑r_L ∧
                    household.beta * household.prices.grossReturn < 1 ∧
                      Aiyagari1994.stationaryAssetSupply household prices.debtLimit
                          (Aiyagari1994.M06C.stationaryLaw household hsmooth hcurvature hnd hbetaR) <
                        K_L
